about: The action-notes-survey page of run 37858085063's answer (its patch left out), and GitHub's answers for the commits and pull requests it credits, cut to the fields the attribution check reads.

page.reason: The action can now survey a registry image as well as local files: it gained an `image` input, runs `notes survey inventory [subject] docker://<image>` when set, makes `subject` optional for images and ignores `input` then. The doc's input table, invariant and recent list were updated.

removed: | subject | yes | — | dashboard label for the surveyed system |
added: | subject | no | "" | dashboard label; required for local files, defaults to the image name without its tag for image surveys |
| input | no | `.` | path to survey (ignored when `image` is set) |
| image | no | "" | OCI/Docker registry image to survey instead of local files, run as `docker://<image>` |
changes.why: action.yml makes subject optional with default "", adds the image input and ignores input when image is set.

removed: - `notes survey inventory` arg order is `<subject> <input>` — changed with CLI v2 args (commit 066f6c1 "update to match new cli args").
added: - `notes survey inventory` arg order is `<subject> <input>` for local files (CLI v2 args, commit 066f6c1 "update to match new cli args"); image mode runs `[subject] docker://<image>` instead, with `input` ignored.
changes.why: action.yml runs image mode as `notes survey inventory [subject] docker://<image>`.

added: - 2026-10-07: image mode corrected to run `notes survey inventory [subject] docker://<image>` — the `image` input added, `subject` optional for images and `input` ignored (PR #30, merge 89cdcdd; commit b455512).
changes.why: PR #30 (merge 89cdcdd) and commit b455512 correct the image input to run notes survey inventory with docker://.

added: - 2026-09-15: image-mode survey added (`image` input) (PR #29, merge f536938; commit 49fadcb).
changes.why: PR #29 (merge f536938) and commit 49fadcb add the image-mode survey.

@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 
 A composite GitHub Action that runs the Notes Co Survey CLI to create an Artifact Dependency Graph (ADG) from a directory of built files (e.g., Rust binaries, OCI layout (unpacked) Docker images, JAR files), then uploads the resulting ADG to the Notes Co servers.
 
-It also supports **image mode**: survey an image from an OCI/Docker registry directly, no local files required. The CLI's `notes survey image` command pulls the image and surveys the pulled OCI layout.
+It also supports **image mode**: survey an image from an OCI/Docker registry directly, no local files required. The action runs `notes survey inventory` with a `docker://` image, which pulls the image and surveys its contents.
 
 ---
 
@@ -22,19 +22,21 @@ Artifact files:
 - name: Build ADG
   uses: notes-co/action-notes-survey@v5
   with:
-    subject: my-app                           # Required — label shown on the dashboard
+    subject: my-app                           # Required for local files: label shown on the dashboard
     input: target/release/                    # Optional; defaults to '.'
     notes_pass: ${{ secrets.NOTES_PASS }}     # Required
 ```
 
-When `image` is set, the action surveys that image instead of local files (the `input` directory is ignored). The CLI expands bare references to their fully-qualified form (`nginx` → `docker.io/library/nginx:latest`, `user/app:tag` → `docker.io/user/app:tag`), pulls the image into an OCI layout with the `oras` baked into the CLI's container image, and surveys the layer blobs.
+When `image` is set, the action surveys that image instead of local files (the `input` directory is ignored). It runs `notes survey inventory [subject] docker://<image>`; an `image` that already starts with `docker://` or `oci://` is passed as is. The CLI expands bare references to their fully-qualified form (`nginx` → `docker.io/library/nginx:latest`, `user/app:tag` → `docker.io/user/app:tag`), pulls the image with the `oras` baked into the CLI's container image, and surveys its contents.
+
+Without `subject`, the survey is labeled with the image name without its tag or digest (`ghcr.io/org/app:v1` → `ghcr.io/org/app`, `nginx:1.27` → `nginx`), so every version of the image lands on one subject.
 
 
 ```yaml
 - name: Build ADG
   uses: notes-co/action-notes-survey@v5
   with:
-    subject: imagename                        # Optional: defaults to image
+    subject: imagename                        # Optional: defaults to the image name without its tag
     image: mycompany/imagename:tag            # Required
     notes_pass: ${{ secrets.NOTES_PASS }}     # Required
 ```
@@ -55,7 +57,7 @@ When `image` is set, the action surveys that image instead of local files (the `
 
 ---
 
-For a private registry, log into it in a prior step (e.g. `docker/login-action`, which writes the runner's `~/.docker/config.json`); the action mounts that docker config read-only into the CLI container, so any registry the runner is already logged into just works. With no docker config on the runner, the pull is anonymous.
+For a private registry, log into it in a prior step (e.g. `docker/login-action`, which writes the runner's `~/.docker/config.json`); the CLI mounts that docker config read-only into its container, so any registry the runner is already logged into just works. A login kept in a credential helper is read for that one registry. With no docker config on the runner, the pull is anonymous.
 
 ```yaml
 - name: Log in to GHCR
@@ -79,7 +81,7 @@ For a private registry, log into it in a prior step (e.g. `docker/login-action`,
 
 | Name | Required | Default | Description |
 |------|----------|---------|-------------|
-| `subject` | Yes | *(none)* | Label identifying the system being surveyed (shown on the dashboard) |
+| `subject` | For local files | *(none)* | Label identifying the system being surveyed (shown on the dashboard). For an image it defaults to the image name without its tag or digest |
 | `input` | No | `.` | Path to local files to survey (ignored when `image` is set) |
 | `image` | No | *(none)* | OCI/Docker registry image to survey instead of local files, e.g. `ghcr.io/org/app:v1` (bare names like `nginx` are expanded by the CLI). Private registries work via the runner's docker login (e.g. `docker/login-action`) |
 | `notes_pass` | Yes | *(none)* | Notes Pass (JWT) from your Notes Co project |
@@ -93,4 +95,4 @@ For a private registry, log into it in a prior step (e.g. `docker/login-action`,
 
 - Docker must be available in the GitHub Actions runner.
 - `notesco/notes-cli` image must be publicly accessible.
-- Image mode requires notes-cli **v1.7.0+** (the `oras` binary and `notes survey image` command are baked into the CLI image since then).
+- Image mode requires a Survey CLI release with `docker://` inputs for `notes survey inventory`. Older CLI images only have `notes survey image`.

@@ -3,14 +3,15 @@ description: "Runs The Notes Co Survey to survey files and upload results."
 
 inputs:
   subject:
-    description: "Label identifying the system being surveyed (shown on the dashboard)"
-    required: true
+    description: "Label identifying the system being surveyed (shown on the dashboard). Required for local files; for an image it defaults to the image name without its tag"
+    required: false
+    default: ""
   input:
     description: "Path to local files to survey (ignored when `image` is set)"
     required: false
     default: "."
   image:
-    description: "OCI/Docker registry image reference to survey (instead of local files), e.g. `ghcr.io/org/app:v1`. Requires notes-cli v1.7.0+ (see README)."
+    description: "OCI/Docker registry image reference to survey (instead of local files), e.g. `ghcr.io/org/app:v1`. Requires a Survey CLI release with docker:// inputs (see README)."
     required: false
     default: ""
   notes_pass:
@@ -44,9 +45,18 @@ runs:
         export NOTES_IMAGE="${{ inputs.cli_image }}"
         export NOTES_IMAGE_TAG="${{ inputs.cli_image_tag }}"
         IMG="${{ inputs.image }}"
+        SUBJECT="${{ inputs.subject }}"
 
         if [ -n "$IMG" ]; then
-          ~/.local/bin/notes survey image "$IMG" --subject "${{ inputs.subject }}" --log-level="${{ inputs.log_level }}"
+          case "$IMG" in
+            docker://*|oci://*) ;;
+            *) IMG="docker://$IMG" ;;
+          esac
+          ~/.local/bin/notes survey inventory ${SUBJECT:+"$SUBJECT"} "$IMG" --log-level="${{ inputs.log_level }}"
         else
-          ~/.local/bin/notes survey inventory "${{ inputs.subject }}" "${{ inputs.input }}" --log-level="${{ inputs.log_level }}"
+          if [ -z "$SUBJECT" ]; then
+            echo "::error::subject is required when surveying local files"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          ~/.local/bin/notes survey inventory "$SUBJECT" "${{ inputs.input }}" --log-level="${{ inputs.log_level }}"
         fi
